# Nomad

> Distributed Minecraft hosting with no always-on coordinator. A shared object
> store (Cloudflare R2, a git repo, or a self-hosted S3-compatible server) is
> the only infrastructure. Each world is three objects under one prefix: a
> compare-and-swap lease that decides who hosts, a world archive that travels
> between hosts, and the archive's SHA-256.
>
> Careful: content generated by command-code is best-effort; verify before use.

## Essentials

- [README](README.md) — overview, protocol, backends, setup, CLI, config, tests, packaging.

## Source layout

- [launcher/cloud.py](launcher/cloud.py) — S3/SigV4 client, `WorldStore`, `Lease`, integrity check, usage counters.
- [launcher/storage/](launcher/storage/) — `WorldStoreProtocol`, `build_store`, and the `r2`, `git`, `vps`, `ssh` backends.
- [launcher/manifest.py](launcher/manifest.py) — inclusion manifest (`nomad.json`): what to sync + how to launch any game.
- [launcher/process_runtime.py](launcher/process_runtime.py) — generic runtime for arbitrary server commands.
- [launcher/tunnel.py](launcher/tunnel.py) — reverse ssh tunnel (publish the game port through a box).
- [launcher/ssh_connection.py](launcher/ssh_connection.py) — one SSH connection shared by storage and tunnel.
- [launcher/ssh_identity.py](launcher/ssh_identity.py) — Nomad keypair: generate, fingerprint, install command, provisioning.
- [launcher/ssh_provision.py](launcher/ssh_provision.py) — guided SSH setup: probe existing access, install the key, create the world folder, verify with IdentitiesOnly.
- [launcher/secrets.py](launcher/secrets.py) — credential redaction and global log-record scrubbing.
- [launcher/audit.py](launcher/audit.py) — non-secret audit trail of credential use.
- [launcher/agent.py](launcher/agent.py) — host lifecycle (acquire -> pull -> install -> boot -> renew -> push -> release).
- [launcher/registry.py](launcher/registry.py) — world address book.
- [launcher/config.py](launcher/config.py) — settings + persistence.
- [launcher/server_properties.py](launcher/server_properties.py) — whitelisted Minecraft server.properties.
- [launcher/minecraft/](launcher/minecraft/) — vanilla runtime (jar download, Java 21 check, process control).
- [launcher/sync/](launcher/sync/) — world folder helpers.
- [launcher/cli/](launcher/cli/) — `nomad` command-line interface.
- [launcher/ui/](launcher/ui/) — PySide6 launcher.
- [launcher/tests/](launcher/tests/) — pytest suite.
- [scripts/app/build_app.py](scripts/app/build_app.py) — PyInstaller + embedded JRE packaging.
- [scripts/app/make_icon.py](scripts/app/make_icon.py) — icon generator.
- [.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml) — test matrix (Linux/Windows/macOS).

## External / upstream

- Cloudflare R2: <https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/>
- MinIO (self-hosted S3 server): <https://min.io/>
- Temurin JRE 21 (embedded runtime): <https://adoptium.net/>
